answer: The ridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the basalt until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ocean of the next round.
